favourite.heading: Why Navy can pull away
bullets: Navy is the better football team by 10.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-10.5 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Navy by 2.1 points: ball control vs front disruption (-2.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why UAB can keep it close
bullets: Playing at UAB is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -31.5 to p90 +12.5 for UAB, so a projection of -8.5 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
